answer: The cheapest real defence: mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because trellis only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. In practice tundra is enforced by the ledger itself: Nothing here needs to be perfect; it only has to make clones cost more than they return. Any vertex approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
